name: Sweet Rascal
signature_dish: Innovative non-vegetarian alfresco plates at an appointment-only owner-chef bistro
why_it_matters: An appointment-only, purely non-vegetarian alfresco bistro run by an owner-chef — Yercaud's most distinctive dining experience, with hundreds of glowing reviews calling it the best food in town. The catchy hand-painted phrases, resident dogs and birds, and inventive sino-indo-continental cooking set it apart from every hotel restaurant on the hill.
insider_tip: You must call ahead — it runs on appointments only and there is no walk-in service. It is strictly non-veg; vegetarians should plan elsewhere. The owner-chef is part of the experience, so allow time to chat.
signature_address: Sweet Rascal, Yercaud, Salem District, Tamil Nadu 636601

name: The Orange Restaurant
signature_dish: Multi-cuisine lunch buffet with North Indian, Chinese, South Indian and continental
why_it_matters: A resort multi-cuisine restaurant with one of Yercaud's most-reviewed kitchens — best known for a value-for-money lunch buffet spanning North Indian, Chinese, South Indian and continental, plus a live-counter breakfast. The default for groups wanting variety in one place.
insider_tip: The lunch buffet is the smart order — wide spread including an interesting dessert table. Breakfast has live counters. Good for families and groups; book ahead at weekends.
signature_address: The Orange Restaurant, Yercaud, Salem District, Tamil Nadu 636601

name: Brook's Bistro
signature_dish: South Indian plates and Shevaroy hill tribal-style dishes
why_it_matters: The restaurant of The Brook Resorts & Spa — a top-ranked Yercaud dining option with strong South Indian cooking and a tribal-food angle drawn from the Shevaroy hill communities. The combination of valley views and a playground makes it a family pick.
insider_tip: Strong on South Indian; ask about the tribal-style dishes if you want something local to the Shevaroy hills. There's a playground for kids, so it works as a leisurely family lunch.
signature_address: Brook's Bistro, The Brook Resorts & Spa, Yercaud, Salem District, Tamil Nadu 636601

name: GRT Nature Trails Sky Rocca Diner
signature_dish: Forest-and-valley-view dining with grilled meats and tandoor
why_it_matters: The diner of GRT's Nature Trails Sky Rocca resort, perched on Yercaud's 20th hairpin bend with a sky-high forest-and-valley view. Strong on grilled meats and tandoor plus a generous breakfast spread — Yercaud's headline view-dining address.
insider_tip: It is up on the ghat road at the 20th hairpin, not in Yercaud town — factor in the drive. Window seats for the valley view; the tandoor and grills are the kitchen's strength.
signature_address: GRT Nature Trails Sky Rocca, 20th hairpin bend, Yercaud Ghat Road, Salem District, Tamil Nadu 636601

name: Hotel Selvam Mess
signature_dish: Tamil rice meals and non-veg curries in a no-frills mess
why_it_matters: A plain Tamil mess in Yercaud town — the honest, cheap counterpoint to the hill's resort restaurants, where locals and budget travellers go for a proper rice meal and home-style curries.
insider_tip: This is a working mess, not a tourist restaurant — go at lunch for the freshest meals. Quick and inexpensive; cash-friendly. Stick to the rice meals and the day's curries.
signature_address: Hotel Selvam Mess, Yercaud town, Salem District, Tamil Nadu 636601

name: Hotel Tamilnadu Yercaud Restaurant (TTDC)
area: TTDC Hotel Tamilnadu, near Yercaud Lake
signature_dish: Home-style Tamil meals at the state tourism hotel by the lake
why_it_matters: The in-house restaurant of the TTDC (Tamil Nadu Tourism) Hotel Tamilnadu, centrally located near Yercaud Lake — a dependable, home-style Tamil meal in the most central spot on the hill, open to non-residents.
insider_tip: Its biggest asset is location — a short walk from Yercaud Lake. Home-style Tamil meals rather than fine dining; good for an unfussy lunch between lake and town.
signature_address: Hotel Tamilnadu Yercaud, near Yercaud Lake, Salem District, Tamil Nadu 636601
